steps.title: A get trap on every read
steps.titleZh: 每次读取都会经过 get 陷阱
steps.text: Reading `proxy.name` runs the `get` trap first. It logs the target, the key (`name string`) and the proxy, then returns `'king ' + target[key]`: `king saber`. After `proxy.name = 'foobar'`, the `set` trap stored `archer` instead, so the next read gives `king archer`.
steps.textZh: 读取 `proxy.name` 时，先运行 `get` 陷阱：它打印目标对象、键（`name string`）和代理本身，然后返回 `'king ' + target[key]`，也就是 `king saber`。执行 `proxy.name = 'foobar'` 之后，`set` 陷阱存进去的却是 `archer`，所以下一次读取得到 `king archer`。

steps.title: The set trap picks the value
steps.text: Assign any other property: the trap ignores your value and stores `ea` in `weapon`. Reading it back runs the `get` trap again.
steps.textZh: 给其他属性赋值：陷阱会忽略你给的值，把 `ea` 存进 `weapon`。读回来时又会经过一次 `get` 陷阱。

steps.title: One listener for the list
steps.text: The `<ul>` has one click listener. A click on an item bubbles up to it, and `event.target.textContent` says which item it was.
steps.textZh: `<ul>` 上只有一个点击监听器。点击某一项时事件冒泡到它，`event.target.textContent` 告诉你点的是哪一项。
